name: Zarza de Montánchez (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and white in the proportions 1:2, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Zarza de Montánchez (a bramble, a cross of Saint James and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Zarza de Montánchez; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Zarza de Montánchez arms — bramble, cross of Saint James and tree
